### Speed parity: aggregate 1.14x after the contiguous CTU canvas

`completed` · `@bpg.milestone.parity-canvas/1` · after `@bpg.milestone.parity-depth0-sao/1`

Replace the per-CTU patch-overlay reconstruction stack with a
contiguous per-CTU canvas (phases 1, 1.5, 2 and 3: canvas overlay,
patch/border-cache retirement, frameless WPP workers), the biggest
single refactor on the audit's list.

### Speed parity: aggregate 1.040x after WPP row-segment handoff and hybrid-CPU cap

`completed` · `@bpg.milestone.parity-handoff-hybrid/1` · after `@bpg.milestone.parity-canvas/1`

Land the WPP row-segment handoff scheduler (idle workers take over
stalled/parked rows) and the hybrid-CPU worker cap for narrow
wavefronts, closing most of the remaining parallel-scheduling gap.

### Speed parity: final aggregate 1.016x after root-TU dedup

`completed` · `@bpg.milestone.parity-root-tu-dedup/1` · target 2026-07-07 · after `@bpg.milestone.parity-handoff-hybrid/1`

Land root-TU dedup (reuse the cheap-winner root-leaf luma result in
materialization) as the closing lever of the speed-parity effort,
reaching practical speed parity with C bpgenc -m9 on the documented
7-image sweep.
